headline: Oregon State breaks clear with Louisville road win
dek: A road victory at Louisville carried Oregon State to thirteen wins, more than any other program in the conference, moving past California Baptist. Oregon State has scored 51 goals across all matches and has not lost since an October defeat at Utah Valley, with NC State visiting next.
displaced_by: Oregon State won at Louisville to reach 13 wins and 51 goals, moving past California Baptist and making the standing dek untrue.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Oregon State's 51 goals stand apart: the other programs sit far closer to each other than any of them sits to the leader, leaving the conference's scoring as a lone frontrunner and a tightly bunched pack.

wire.line: Wyatt Borso has 15 goals for Oregon State, more than any other player in the conference.

findings.text: California Baptist has conceded eighteen goals while scoring 33 across its matches.

last_match.line: Oregon State won away from home after back-to-back road defeats at Cal Poly and Utah Valley.

next_match.line: Oregon State has won every home match since its October loss to Cal State Bakersfield.
